chunk_findings.detail: The test verifies only that `T1`’s `needs` list shrinks after each `abandon --drop-edges` and that `doctor` no longer reports stuck edges; it never checks that `D1`/`D2` were actually marked abandoned. A regression in which `abandon --drop-edges` deletes the dependent edges but leaves the decisions’ own state unchanged would still produce the same `show T1` needs (`["D2"]` then `[]`) and the same clean `doctor` output, so this test would pass while the promised abandonment did not occur.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_abandoned_prereq.py:test_two_abandoned_needs_leave_no_stuck_edge_and_drop_only_the_abandoned_edge

chunk_findings.detail: The new fake `pre-commit` stub reports `tests....Passed` whenever `SKIP` does not contain the exact token `tests`, regardless of whether the test hook actually had test files to run. In the “hook skipped for want of a test file is unavailable” scenario named in the comment, `SKIP` is unset (or does not name `tests`), so the stub still prints `tests....Passed`; CI will then see the tests hook as available/passed even though the hook should be unavailable. Any test in this file relying on missing-test-file/unavailable behavior passes vacuously because the stub forces a passed test hook. The stub should suppress or mark the hook unavailable when there are no test files (or only report it after actually invoking the fake test hook), not merely based on `SKIP`.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_ci_selected_scope.py:44

chunk_findings.detail: The two `plan_for` patches were only renamed to `plan_for_offer` on the same module object `P`. The bug this change claims to close says those call sites moved from `pull.plan_for` to `planning.plan_for_offer`. `monkeypatch.setattr(P, "plan_for_offer", ...)` still targets pull: if `plan_for_offer` is not an attribute of pull, pytest raises `AttributeError` before either test body runs; if a leftover name exists on pull but launch tick now calls `planning.plan_for_offer`, the stub never intercepts the real function. Either way the suite still fails, or passes without covering the moved helper.
